- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:513-514 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When `--repo=origin` supplies the repository, the parser treats the first positional refspec as the repository instead.
  WHY: `git push --repo=origin HEAD:feature/x` is a valid push to `origin`, but the guard attempts to resolve `HEAD:feature/x` as the repository and blocks the push; qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputes this diagnosis, stating that the first positional takes precedence over `--repo`.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1303-1310 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new `test_unmappable_push_destination_blocks_without_lookup` cases assert that `--repo=origin` plus a refspec is unmappable, codifying the parser's incorrect destination handling.
  WHY: `origin` is configured in the `merged_branch_repo` fixture, so resolving the repository supplied by `--repo` should not treat the refspec as an unmappable destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1455-1486 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Moving the `if not branch: continue` skip after destination resolution changes failed destination resolution from a confirmation prompt to a hard block.
  WHY: Valid `git push --repo=<remote> HEAD:branch` commands that previously allowed confirmation now return code 2 with no in-band override short of `CLAUDE_PR_MERGE_GUARD=off`.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1063-1064 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `test_positional_remote_probe_failure_requires_confirmation` expects `(code, message) == (0, "")`, but the changed code path hard-blocks when destination resolution fails.
  WHY: The test's `timed_out_config` monkeypatch makes `_remote_push_urls("origin", cwd)` return `[]`, after which `extract_repo_slug("origin")` fails; the test will receive code 2 instead of the asserted result.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1063-1064 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test name `test_positional_remote_probe_failure_requires_confirmation` is misleading after its assertion was changed to expect blocking.
  WHY: The test passes while covering a hard-deny path, so its name may mislead maintainers searching for confirmation behavior.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1455-1486 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Moving the detached-branch early skip after destination resolution adds remote-resolution work to valid pushes from detached HEAD.
  WHY: The reordered path can perform `git config --get remote.*` calls before the early skip, adding latency and attempting remote resolution where the prior path returned immediately.
